caption: The drawing depicts a textile object resembling a section of a quilt or fabric swatch laid out on a plain, light background. The upper portion of the composition displays a square of rich, dark reddish-brown velvet bordered with gold and blue trim. Inside the upper right corner of this square is a patchwork segment featuring triangular fabric pieces in muted tones of blue, beige, brown, and cream radiating outward from a central black patch with green, red, and white floral embroidery. Adjacent to this patchwork, a piece of gray fabric with faint stitched patterns occupies the top right corner. The bottom edge of the velvet square is bordered by blue and beige braid trim, and below it extends a section of delicate, white lace with a faint blue hue at the sides, forming a scalloped edge. The composition primarily consists of fabric textures and stitched elements in subdued and earthy colors, rendered in detail.
title: Crazy Quilt: Detail
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
